create_application.description: Create an AppConfig application: the container for a service's environments and configuration profiles.

mock_response.description: Feature flags and settings for checkout
mock_response.name: checkout-service

create_application.name: create_application

parameters.description: The application's name, up to 64 characters.
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.description: An optional description, up to 1,024 characters.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Optional tag names and values, such as team = platform. Up to 50 tags; names up to 128 characters, values up to 256.
parameters.name: tags

create_configuration_profile.description: Create a configuration profile in AppConfig's hosted store. Save its content with 'Create a hosted configuration version'.
create_configuration_profile.name: create_configuration_profile

parameters.description: The AppConfig application. Pick one, or give its ID, its name, its ARN, or the link to its page in the AppConfig console.
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.description: The profile's name, up to 128 characters.
parameters.name: profile_name

parameters.description: Freeform holds any configuration. Feature flags holds flags in AppConfig's feature flag format.
parameters.name: profile_type

parameters.description: An optional description, up to 1,024 characters.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Optional JSON Schema every deployed version must match, such as {"type": "object"}. AppConfig checks it when a deployment starts.
parameters.name: json_schema

parameters.description: Optional tag names and values, such as team = platform. Up to 50 tags; names up to 128 characters, values up to 256.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: The AppConfig application. Pick one, or give its ID, its name, its ARN, or the link to its page in the AppConfig console.

parameters.description: The configuration. An object from an earlier step is saved as JSON. For JSON it is checked before sending.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: The format of the content.

parameters.description: An optional note, up to 1,024 plain ASCII characters (AppConfig sends it in an HTTP header).
